freeze_boundary: Declared 2026-10-30 before any Phase F row ran. Criteria are fixed for these rows; failures are preserved and diagnosed, not re-scored.

common.resolution: 1 mm particles, 4 mm grid, 0.1 ms material dt, 20 ms control dt, seed 42, kinematic ideal tracking (no robot)
common.law: cutting law 8 (tlmpm_v4; tlmpm_v5 for rows with more than 2 cuts)
common.knife: ruler_knife_v2_y (tip toward +y, ADR 0013), unless the row names another
always_report: component masses and recorded total mass vs sampler mass
label distance to the actual swept surface
mean/max material reaction on the blade
common.mass_conservation: recorded mass equals the task sampler mass within the frozen tolerance in every row (also a pass condition of every row)

F2.1_gate_14.setup: TRIM-02-K2 workpiece, double bevel, rho = 14 deg skim
F2.1_gate_14.pass: above-plane removal >= 0.9 and substrate share >= 0.99 (trim_separation); report plowing fraction

F2.3_inplane_v2.setup: CUT-03-K2 vertical in-plane cut with the v2 knife
F2.3_inplane_v2.pass: frozen strict oracle PASS (two parts, mass, location <= 2 mm, persistence)

F2.4_rocking.setup: CUT-03-K2 geometry; edge rotates +/-10 deg about the blade normal (period 0.8 s) while descending through the bar
F2.4_rocking.pass: two substantial parts (>= 40% each, >= 99% together); no particle farther than 2 particle spacings from the actual swept surface sits in the opposite-side component; report the interface statistic

F2.5_pure_rotation.setup: armed half-depth vertical cut, then 0.5 s armed rotation of the edge about its centre (+/-8 deg about the blade normal, no centre translation), then armed withdrawal
F2.5_pure_rotation.pass: one component (ligament kept); no label beyond 1 reference cell outside the region the moving edge segments actually swept; report stroke state during the rotation

F2.6_saw_cut.setup: CUT-03-K2 vertical cut with sawing (+/-6 mm along the edge, 0.4 s period) while descending

F2.6_pure_draw.setup: armed half-depth vertical cut, then 0.8 s armed sawing in place (draw only, no advance), then armed withdrawal
F2.6_pure_draw.pass: one component; no label more than 1 reference cell below the deepest edge position reached

F2.7_withdrawal_v2.setup: CUT-03-K2 armed half-depth cut then armed withdrawal
F2.7_withdrawal_v2.pass: one component; core band below the stop 100% code 0 (ADR 0008 ligament definition); labels unchanged during withdrawal

F2.8_finite_edge.setup: CUT-02 wide bar (60 mm) cut vertically with the edge offset along its line so only about half the bar width is under the edge
F2.8_finite_edge.pass: one component (uncut side keeps it connected); no label with |l| > L (edge half-length) at assignment; severed bonds only within the edge span

F2.9_flat_press.setup: blade lying flat on the bar top, armed, pressed -z
F2.9_flat_press.pass: zero new labels; one component; mean |F| over steps with tool-material contact > 1 N (contact window, replacing the C4 all-steps mean)

F2.9_blunt_handle.setup: armed; v2 grip (blunt handle) pressed against the bar side
F2.9_blunt_handle.pass: zero new labels; one component; mean |F| over steps with grip-material contact > 0.1 N (contact window)

F2.9_side_push.setup: armed side push of the blade face into the bar end
F2.9_side_push.pass: zero new labels; one component; mean |F| over contact steps > 0.1 N

F2.9_no_contact.setup: armed skim 3 mm above the dome

F2.10_recontact.setup: after a full vertical cut, the blade face (cut disabled) pushes one piece back against the other for 0.5 s
F2.10_recontact.pass: components stay 2 (no re-merge); particle-particle contact impulses between the two pieces are nonzero; zero label changes while disarmed

F2.11_multicut_history.setup: tlmpm_v5, 3 sequential cuts on a supported (slotted) bar, then a disarmed blade push between pieces
F2.11_multicut_history.pass: 4 mechanical parts; every earlier digit unchanged after later cuts and after the push; zero slot overflow

F3_resolution.setup: CUT-03-K2 and TRIM-02-K2-R10 at (spacing, grid, dt) = formal (1 mm, 4 mm, 0.1 ms); coarse (2 mm, 8 mm, 0.2 ms); dt-half (1 mm, 4 mm, 0.05 ms); medium (1.5 mm, 6 mm, 0.15 ms)
F3_resolution.pass: characterization only: report separation outcome, component masses, surface metrics (TRIM), mean/max contact wrench, cut location, numerical stability (no NaN/inversion), wall time; formal row must reproduce its formal PASS
